source.author: Alan Leo
source.basis: User-supplied page scans transcribed and normalized for Orbo.

editorial_policy.interpretation_status: editorial abstraction from Leo's delineations, not verbatim source text

engine_rules.mutual_aspects_definition: Aspects formed between planets themselves, apart from the luminaries.
engine_rules.house_modification: Interpretation is modified by the houses occupied and ruled by the planets involved.

planetary_modifiers.Saturn: Restricts, delays, limits, and retards the planet it aspects.
planetary_modifiers.Mars: Quickens, impels, energizes, and reduces restraint.

parallel_rule.character: more inclining/background than compelling in several of Leo's delineations

engine_rules.lunar_modifier: Many mutual aspects become materially stronger, weaker, or timed by concurrent lunar aspects.

directionality.default: Interpret the progressed planet aspecting the radical planet when that distinction matters.
directionality.explicit_exception_example: Paragraph 121 gives separate meanings for progressed Mercury square radical Venus and progressed Venus square radical Mercury.

availability_constraints.Mercury-Venus_trine: cannot form during the normal span of earthly life according to Leo
availability_constraints.Mercury-Venus_opposition: cannot form during the normal span of earthly life according to Leo

records.engine_note: Leo explicitly distinguishes progressed Mercury square radical Venus from progressed Venus square radical Mercury. The same geometric square is interpreted according to which planet is progressed.

records.core_meaning: Leo says these progressed aspects cannot form within a normal human lifespan
records.engine_note: Leo states that progressed Mercury–Venus trine and opposition cannot form during the normal span of earthly life.
